author: nickyeow

english.text: Could you give me some change for this ten dollar bill?

jyutping: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 coeng3 saan2 ne1 zoeng1 sap6 man1 zi2 aa3？
text: 你可唔可以幫我唱散呢張十蚊紙呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: If you'll keep an eye on the kids, I'll take your suit to be cleaned.

jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 tai2 zyu6 di1 sai3 lou6，ngo5 zau6 bong1 nei5 lo2 tou3 sai1 zong1 heoi3 sai2。
text: 你幫我睇住啲細路，我就幫你攞套西裝去洗。

author: tigro1973

english.text: The room was devoid of furniture.

jyutping: gaan1 fong4 mou5 gaa1 si1。
text: 間房冇傢俬。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I feel that I understand your feelings.

jyutping: nei5 ge3 sam1 cing4 ngo5 nam2 ngo5 ming4 baak6 ge2。
text: 你嘅心情我諗我明白嘅。

author: kaenif

english.text: He is a doctor and an author.

jyutping: keoi5 hai6 go3 ji1 sang1，jau6 hai6 go3 zok3 gaa1。
text: 佢係個醫生，又係個作家。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What the bloody fuck is that?

jyutping: mat1 lan2 je5 lai4 gaa4？
text: 乜撚嘢嚟㗎？

author: fercheung

english.text: Tom is clearing the garden.

jyutping: aa3 Tom hai2 dou6 zing2 gan2 faa1 jyun2。
text: 阿Tom喺度整緊花園。

author: nickyeow

english.text: My watch gains one minute a day.

jyutping: ngo5 zek3 biu1 mui5 jat6 faai3 jat1 fan1 zung1。
text: 我隻錶每日快一分鐘。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You're certain that you've never met her before?

jyutping: nei5 hang2 ding6 nei5 mei6 gin3 gwo3 keoi5？
text: 你肯定你未見過佢？

author: nickyeow

english.text: She runs a beauty shop.

jyutping: keoi5 hoi1 mei5 jung4 jyun2。
text: 佢開美容院。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I just need some time alone.

jyutping: ngo5 zing6 hai6 soeng2 jiu3 siu2 siu2 si1 jan4 si4 gaan1 ze1。
text: 我淨係想要少少私人時間啫。

author: nickyeow

english.text: She's neither in the kitchen nor in the living room.

jyutping: keoi5 m4 hai2 cyu4 fong4，jik6 dou1 m4 hai2 haak3 teng1。
text: 佢唔喺廚房，亦都唔喺客廳。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I have a degree in philosophy.

jyutping: ngo5 jau5 zit3 hok6 hok6 wai2。
text: 我有哲學學位。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What kind of monster would do such a thing?

jyutping: hai6 mai6 jan4 lai4 gaa4，gam3 dou1 zou6 dak1 ceot1 ge3？
text: 係咪人嚟㗎，咁都做得出嘅？

author: aizilan

english.text: What?
What did you just say?
Pardon?
I beg your pardon?

jyutping: me1 waa2？
text: 咩話？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Don't ask questions that you don't want to know the answer to.

jyutping: m4 hou2 man6 di1 nei5 m4 soeng2 zi1 dou3 daap3 on3 ge3 man6 tai4。
text: 唔好問啲你唔想知道答案嘅問題。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Mary is obnoxious, isn't she?

jyutping: Mary dou1 gei2 hat1 jan4 zang1 gaa3 wo3。
text: Mary都幾乞人憎㗎喎。

author: cheeseisdisgusting

english.text: It's better to warm it up on the stove than to microwave it.

jyutping: hai2 lou4 soeng6 hing3 hou2 gwo3 hai2 mei4 bo1 lou4 ding1。
text: 喺爐上㷫好過喺微波爐叮。

author: cheeseisdisgusting

english.text: Dad used to always make this kind of lemonade for you.

jyutping: de1 di4 go2 zan6 si4 seng4 jat6 dou1 zing2 ne1 zung2 ning2 seoi2 bei2 nei5 jam2。
text: 爹哋嗰陣時成日都整呢種檸水俾你飲。

author: WilliamKwok

english.text: Tom eats very little.

jyutping: Tom sik6 dak1 hou2 siu2。
text: Tom食得好少。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We need to hire a new manager.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ceng2 jat1 go3 san1 ge3 ging1 lei5。
text: 我哋要請一個新嘅經理。

english.text: In the late 1990s, I inherited an expensive black Australian Outback jacket from a slightly corpulent homestay Japanese student Hirotada, who stayed in my home on Lulu Island for five years. He was going to a college to learn English. It is really difficult for most Japanese to learn English, because the structure and usage are so different. They seldom fraternize with native Anglophones, because of an entirely different culture.

jyutping: 1990 nin4 doi6 mut6，ngo5 cung4 jat1 go3 loek6 jim4 fei4 bun6 ge3 gei3 suk1 jat6 bun2 hok6 saang1 gwong2 tin4 sau2 soeng6 gai3 sing4 zo2 jat1 gin6 gwai3 ge3 hak1 sik1 ou3 zau1 Outback ngoi6 tou3，keoi5 hai2 ngo5 hai2 lou6 lou6 dou2 ge3 uk1 kei2 zyu6 zo2 ng5 nin4 ge3 jat6 bun2 jan4 jiu3 hok6 jing1 man2，jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 git3 kau3 tung4 jung6 faat3 hou2 m4 tung4，jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 hou2 siu2 tung4 mou5 jyu5 jing1 jyu5 jan4 zou6 hing1 dai6，jan1 wai6 jyun4 cyun4 m4 tung4 ge3 man4 faa3。
text: 1990年代末，我從一個略嫌肥胖嘅寄宿日本學生廣田手上繼承咗一件貴嘅黑色澳洲 Outback 外套，佢喺我喺露露島嘅屋企住咗五年嘅日本人要學英文，因為佢哋嘅結構同用法好唔同，因為佢哋好少同母語英語人做兄弟，因為完全唔同嘅文化。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Igider translated into the Kabyle language well-known poems such as Jugurtha and The Drunken boat by Arthur Rimbaud, El Desdichado by Gérard de Nerval, The Lake and The isolation by Alphonse de Lamartine, The poetic art by Paul Verlaine, Sea Breeze by Stéphane Mallarmé, The Clock by Charles Baudelaire, Tomorrow at dawn by Victor Hugo and other poems by other poets.

text: 伊吉德將著名詩歌翻譯成卡比勒語，例如阿瑟 · 蘭波嘅《朱古塔》同《醉船》、傑拉德 · 德 · 內瓦爾嘅《埃爾德迪查多》、阿爾方斯 · 德 · 拉馬丁嘅《湖》同《隔離》、保羅 · 韋蘭嘅《詩藝術》、斯蒂芬 · 馬勒梅嘅《海風》、查爾斯 · 胡羅戈嘅《黎明》同其他詩人維克托 · 胡羅戈嘅《帽子》、湯姆 · 胡羅戈嘅其他詩歌。
